statement.p: Find the flux of the vector field \vec J = 5 y^2 z\, \vec j+3 x\, \vec k out of the closed box 0\le x\le 2, 0\le y\le 2, 0\le z\le 2.

static.solution: \mbox{div }\vec J = 10 y z, if W is the interior of the box, the Divergence Theorem gives \hbox{Flux } = \int_W 10 y z\,dV = \int_0^{2}\int_0^{2}\int_0^{2} 10 y z\,dx\,dy\,dz = \frac{5}{2} x\bigg|_0^{2} y^2\bigg|_0^{2} z^2\bigg|_0^{2} = 80.
